queries.query: LLM network configuration generation OR "network configuration" "large language model" OR "LLM"
queries.rationale: Primary literature on using LLMs to generate device/configuration artifacts for NetOps (direct phenomenon: LLM->configs).

queries.query: intent-to-configuration translation "intent to configuration" OR "intent-driven" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Studies and methods that map natural-language intent to concrete network configs (operational workflow & correctness concerns).

queries.query: generate-validate-repair "network configuration" OR "configuration repair" "LLM" OR "large language model"
queries.rationale: Pipelines that combine generation, deterministic validation, and automated repair—central mitigation architecture for unsafe outputs.

queries.query: formal verification network configurations "VeriFlow" OR "Header Space Analysis" OR "NetPlumber" OR "network verification"
queries.rationale: Deterministic/ formal validators used in NetOps to check correctness properties (reachability, isolation, ACL semantics) — essential verifier baselines.

queries.query: LLM hallucination factuality code generation "hallucination" "code generation" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Mechanisms and characterizations of hallucination and factual errors in LLM outputs (mechanisms causing NetOps faults).
Agentic architectures where LLMs call validators/tools (LangChain-style tool invocation, verifier-assisted loops) relevant to guarded NetOps agents.

queries.query: constrained decoding controlled generation "constrained generation" "controlled decoding" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Techniques to enforce syntactic/semantic constraints at generation time (mitigation mechanism for producing valid configurations).

queries.query: benchmarks LLM networking "NetOps benchmark" OR "network configuration benchmark" OR "AIOps benchmark" "6G-Bench" "TSNBench" "OpsEval"
queries.rationale: Existing evaluation suites relevant to NetOps; necessary to assess benchmark validity and nearest-work gaps.
Methods for stress-testing LLMs (perturbation/attack design), transferable to NetOps safety evaluations.

queries.query: emulation and simulation environments NetOps "Mininet" "ns-3" "GNS3" "network emulator"
queries.rationale: Practical experimental platforms used to execute or validate configuration changes and measure operational impact (methods & metrics).

queries.query: metrics for configuration correctness "reachability" "isolation" "policy compliance" "ACL correctness"
queries.rationale: Operationally meaningful correctness metrics to assess LLM-generated NetOps outputs (benchmark validity & construct validity).
Studies where LLMs assist fault diagnosis/repair (operational workflows, failure modes, human-in-loop comparisons).
Human oversight, trust, and explainability studies for operational adoption and mitigation strategies.

queries.query: adversarial attacks on configuration systems "configuration poisoning" "malicious configuration" network security "adversarial"
queries.rationale: Threat models where malicious inputs or prompts induce unsafe NetOps outputs; informs mitigation and threat analysis.

queries.query: datasets public network configurations "public network configuration dataset" OR "router configs dataset" "CAIDA"
queries.rationale: Sources of real or synthetic configuration data for experiments and reproducibility (data procurement & external validity).

queries.query: LLMs for code synthesis and program repair "program repair" "code generation" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Adjacent domain (code gen/repair) with mature generate-verify-repair methods and evaluation practices transferable to NetOps configs.

queries.query: neural-symbolic methods combining ML and formal verification "neuro-symbolic" "SMT" "hybrid verification"
queries.rationale: Architectures combining statistical models and symbolic/verifier components—relevant mitigation mechanisms for correctness guarantees.

queries.query: real-world NetOps automation case studies "network automation" "intent-based networking" "Cisco DNA" "Ansible" "NetConf"
queries.rationale: Operational integrations, real-product automation workflows, and constraints that affect experimental realism and external validity.

inclusion_criteria: Primary-source technical literature (peer-reviewed conference/journal papers) or publicly accessible preprints (arXiv) with methodology and results.
Works addressing LLMs, generative models, NetOps, network configuration, verification, AIOps, or closely transferable methods (e.g., code synthesis/repair).
Public datasets, tools, simulators, or software whose provenance is clear and reproducible.
Publicly available technical reports or workshop papers that include experiments or detailed designs.
Publications between 2010 and 2026 (inclusive) to capture seminal verification work and recent LLM developments through 2026-08-31.
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing materials or vendor claim pages without empirical methods or reproducible evidence.
Short-form blog posts, news articles, social-media threads, or secondary summaries unless authored by credible research groups and backed by a citable source.
Works without accessible metadata (missing authors, title, venue, or stable identifier) or unverifiable provenance.
Datasets or configurations behind restrictive NDAs or inaccessible private corpora (must be publicly available).
Papers outside the topic family and not transferable (e.g., unrelated NLP tasks without method transferability).
date_rationale: Range 2010–2026 chosen to include seminal network-verification and NetOps automation literature (often earlier than LLM era) while covering all LLM/agentic developments through the current cutoff (up to 2026-08-31). This balances historical mechanisms (verification, emulation) with newest generative-AI work relevant to NetOps.
